content_patterns: Success confirmation pattern: green check circle + plain statement 'Expense Saved' + date. Receipt-derived data presented as labeled key-value rows; embedded line-item breakdown with right-aligned bold amounts ('Indomie Rp 30.000', 'Milk Rp 50.000', 'Vegetables Rp 120.000', 'Other Rp 150.000'). Localized category label ('Konsumsi'). Money formatted Indonesian-style with dot separators and 'Rp' prefix. Paired bottom actions: neutral 'Edit' vs destructive tinted 'Delete', icon + label each.
notable_interactions: Green check implies just-completed save from OCR flow; no further processing UI. Merchant/Category rows imply tappable editing (no chevrons visible, but paired Edit button covers it). Edit/Delete split-button footer implies record management. Back arrow implies return to previous screen (likely expenses list). Total amount rendered in red draws attention to the expense size; not necessarily an error state.
